notes: Lava buckets put into the network are kept now. Before, a lava bucket put in through the Network Terminal (dropped on a cell or shift-clicked) was lost when no crate already held lava buckets, and dropping one on the empty-bucket cell left you with the empty buckets and no lava. Lava buckets now go into an empty crate or a free Deepcore Chest slot, and anything the network cannot store comes back to you. Also in 4.59.0: Shift-click now puts items into the Network Terminal, even when the page is full of items (it had no empty slot to land in). Items the network has no room for go back to you. Also in 4.58.0: the network merges part stacks of the same item across its Deepcore Chests, so one item no longer takes a slot in every chest. Earlier: Network Terminal search works like the crafting table's and the Network Crafter's: tap Search, type a name (and pick the sort) in the box, then tap the terminal again for the results. Show all clears the search. Also in 4.56.0: the Network Crafter has a Show all button next to Search: it clears the search and shows everything the network can make. Also in 4.55.0: Network Terminal: every item shows how many the whole network holds right on its slot, like a crate's front (8.1k); point at it for the exact number. Taking one still gives a stack. Also in 4.53.0: items you put in a networked Deepcore Chest now move by themselves into a networked crate that already holds (or is locked to) the same item, while that crate has room. Also in 4.52.0: the Network Cable has a new look (black cable with green lights).
